A LOSS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u032-b0062", "target": "— Баркис, дорогой мой! — сказала Пегготи почти бодро, склоняясь над ним, а мы с её братом стояли в ногах кровати. — Вот мой милый мальчик, мой милый мальчик, мастер Дэви, который нас свёл, Баркис! Которого ты посылал с поручениями, помнишь! Разве ты не скажешь слово мастеру Дэви?", "source_sha256": "d926ebbf89c239f32848d96474a2ca264de19c60e65b42889c50f41b4d77b553", "target_id": "ru-en85-u032-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a71d3a4fb0b2fb3f4360516f7cc6fa3f8823d21267271fead71f6c47bb9736a1"}, {"source_id": "en85-u032-b0063", "target": "Он был нем и бесчувствен, как сундук, от которого его тело получало единственное своё выражение.", "source_sha256": "9845bd9d28532976d9cee7f342908252bd964281fa4c24422f275eb2356b8c07", "target_id": "ru-en85-u032-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8373cb626f74451cbd829407ddf641399f585f1568fa6269c6e892357e9b35b5"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 30, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u032-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘He’s a going out with the tide,’ said Mr. Peggotty to me, behind his hand.", "sha256": "73a3f0c43c27a4a02fb7a60ba617da39fc51fa5c319045ccb355f827a0410074", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My eyes were dim and so were Mr. Peggotty’s; but I repeated in a whisper, ‘With the tide?’", "sha256": "f39e9f6a6fd5ff3c8a111952f7401fdb97300bd2791b2610dbb424a5dc957307", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘People can’t die, along the coast,’ said Mr. Peggotty, ‘except when the tide’s pretty nigh out. They can’t be born, unless it’s pretty nigh in—not properly born, till flood. He’s a going out with the tide. It’s ebb at half-arter three, slack water half an hour. If he lives till it turns, he’ll hold his own till past the flood, and go out with the next tide.’", "sha256": "595be5f02e2e7ed97cef6adfd57bbe4bf07be458af85ec621fc66a111efe3656", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We remained there, watching him, a long time—hours. What mysterious influence my presence had upon him in that state of his senses, I shall not pretend to say; but when he at last began to wander feebly, it is certain he was muttering about driving me to school.", "sha256": "af7fe7adefaaec780f3bf91fae264fe010965544608c91473863981b8a595f69", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘He’s coming to himself,’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "db784620886f06427a835d70670e0871889cd2854ac526f5257dd40a4b030984", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Peggotty touched me, and whispered with much awe and reverence. ‘They are both a-going out fast.’", "sha256": "9936fdcf5d585301e42790c0c95a378c1e131b7e1df20bf6715a820745ad7ec5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Barkis, my dear!’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "4586c581091ed49881e34f5af394ed83597969829bd11f5b75c071777a923f9b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘C. P. Barkis,’ he cried faintly. ‘No better woman anywhere!’", "sha256": "120bdba67939779cf43555b14775e5d06ab3198dc694f5f75929e02a12dbc81f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Look! Here’s Master Davy!’ said Peggotty. For he now opened his eyes.", "sha256": "ad3b039e5fdda1ec0b6f2005691de13105b28bfb4f79b430ffd997727017175f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0073", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was on the point of asking him if he knew me, when he tried to stretch out his arm, and said to me, distinctly, with a pleasant smile:", "sha256": "e8260e154d67b137fd56c381c4ed5c3355f51e9b1a72ac515cea5f8f76f075c8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[73]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0074", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Barkis is willin’!’", "sha256": "c644b2dbb42a22d47f80088a030e8e2942af9205bfc643c6bef773a4390b91f4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[74]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u032-b0075", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "And, it being low water, he went out with the tide.", "sha256": "b92528f100d23860179e82d4150a8ac5b7174b16981147a1ae43d1221c2efa15", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[75]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
